sources.title: ESLint selective inline suppression regions and lines
sources.sections_read: Disable Rules; line/range directives; descriptions; unused directives
sources.confirmed: Rules can be disabled for selected source spans or individual lines, with rule names and explanatory comments; disabled code must still parse.
sources.limits: The scope is a line or explicit comment range rather than an AST block; suppressed source must still parse, so it does not supply conditional compilation. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C16.json.

sources.title: GCC diagnostic push/pop and preprocessor conditionals
sources.sections_read: Diagnostic state; push/pop; location-dependent warning controls
sources.confirmed: Diagnostic settings can be changed at source positions and restored with push/pop; only some diagnostics are controllable.
sources.limits: These are textual spans, not annotations attached to syntax nodes; restoration must be explicit, only some warnings are controllable, and preprocessor conditions cannot use runtime locals. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C16.json.

sources.title: Splint declaration annotations and bounded control comments
sources.confirmed: The manual documents local checking flags, declaration-specific unused annotations, bounded suppression regions, and suppression-count checks.
sources.limits: Comment ranges require explicit termination; they do not automatically follow brace scope, and broad suppression can hide new errors. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C16.json.

sources.title: Checker Framework local-declaration @SuppressWarnings
sources.confirmed: A suppression on a local declaration covers its initializer, not later uses; statements and blocks are not valid annotation targets.
sources.limits: The documented annotation cannot attach to arbitrary statements or blocks; this is explicitly later evidence. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: post_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C16.json.

sources.title: Frama-C ACSL statement and block contracts
sources.version_or_date: Version 1.7; copyright 2009–2013; exact publication date unverified
sources.confirmed: ACSL defines contracts attached to statements and blocks, including modification and exit conditions. The versioned manual bears a 2009–2013 copyright range.
sources.limits: This is a verification-contract mechanism, not lint suppression or conditional compilation; abrupt exits require distinct semantics, and declaration attachment was not established. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C16.json.
